title:
Comment of Nicole Graffam in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151680.txt
documents.text:
Nicole Graffam, Wiscasset, ME.
I am writing to express my opposition to the proposed underwater data center in the Bay of Fundy. This project would have negative impacts on the marine ecosystem by raising the water temperature, causing noise pollution that would disrupt marine life, and damage the seabed during installation. This area is critical habitat for the highly endangered North Atlantic right whale, of which only around 372 individuals remain. We need nature. We need clean air and water and healthy ecosystems, including marine environments. We don't need the generative AI powered by these facilities.
